questions.label: Assistance/Information Needed:
options: Food Pantry: a wide variety of fruit, veggies, grains, proteins, and toiletries (pickup available twice a month)
Food Vouchers: $10 vouchers, based on availability at BK Campus Eats, Ovi's Place, Jupioca, or Brooklyn's Best Eats
External Food: grocery store gift cards to Key Food, Food Emporium, Food Universe, SuperFresh, Food Dynasty (pickup based on availability)
Social Services: meet with a social worker for help with housing, health insurance, and other resources
